title: FootFlex Service & Customer Support Policy & FAQs
content: FootFlex is dedicated to providing world-class customer service and resolution. Customers can reach our support team through multiple dedicated channels: 1) Official Email Support at support@footflex.com, 2) 24/7 FootFlex AI Assistant Chatbot available on our website and mobile platform, 3) Live Customer Care Representatives available Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST. Our Service Level Agreement (SLA) guarantees a response within 24 hours for email support tickets. For unresolved complaints, customers can contact our designated Grievance Officer at grievance@footflex.com.

faqs.question: How can I contact FootFlex Customer Support?
faqs.answer: You can reach us by emailing support@footflex.com or by interacting with our live FootFlex AI Assistant Chatbot on the website.

faqs.question: What are the customer support working hours?
faqs.answer: Our live support team operates Monday through Saturday, from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST. Our AI Chatbot is available 24/7.

faqs.question: What is the expected email response time (SLA)?
faqs.answer: We respond to all customer email inquiries within 24 business hours.

faqs.question: How do I report a missing item, damaged product, or wrong shipment?
faqs.answer: Send an email to support@footflex.com with your Order ID, clear unboxing photos/video, and a description of the issue within 48 hours of delivery.

faqs.question: Who is the Grievance Redressal Officer for FootFlex?
faqs.answer: For escalated compliance or unresolved issues, email our Grievance Officer at grievance@footflex.com with your ticket reference number.
